name: Swish
title: Making repeat food orders easier.
summary: A case study on saved addresses, delivery timing, repeat meals, and clearer price comparisons for frequent users.
boundary: Independent proposal; not work commissioned by Swish.

name: Headout
title: Helping new users find the right experience faster.
summary: A case study on reducing onboarding steps and improving early recommendations, supported by an interactive prototype.
boundary: Proposed improvements; no measured adoption claims.

name: Pronto
title: Making checkout easier to trust.
summary: A case study that identifies checkout problems and turns them into a simpler booking flow and testable prototype.
boundary: Independent exploration of checkout and booking.

name: Loans24
title: Making premises verification easier to complete.
summary: A case study on guiding users through evidence capture while protecting privacy and reducing avoidable errors.
boundary: Proposed verification flow; not a launched feature.

name: Foobar
title: Testing an AI-guided deployment flow.
summary: A technical prototype for generating scripts and guiding deployment. The server and deployment backend are simulated.
boundary: Simulated deployment; inspect the code or try the flow.

name: Cycle-synced tracker
title: A workout that meets you where you are.
summary: A one-hour build exploring cycle-aware workout suggestions and YouTube recommendations, with no account needed.
boundary: Personal experiment; no adoption or health-outcome claims.
